name: Cecilia
anti_trude_vector: Topological Pasture-to-Asphalt Palimpsest & Goatherd Bell Compass: double-exposed Canvas 2D continuous street sprawl engulfing named Mediterranean pastures into concrete traffic islands, paired with bespoke <cecilia-*> and <cec-*> custom DOM elements.

canonical_stones.label: Barefoot Goatherd of Named Pastures
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: First encounter: barefoot youth driving jingling nimble goats who knows every pasture by name while cities remain nameless leafless intervals.

canonical_stones.label: Leafless Interval & Watchmen Gates
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Paved stone streets where goats startle and scatter at corners until watchmen and toll-collectors drive the herd outside.

canonical_stones.label: Meadow of the Low Sage
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Primary pasture known to the youth, later buried beneath and recognized within a concrete traffic island.

canonical_stones.label: The Goat's Slope
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Steep thyme-and-broom limestone pasture engulfed by viaducts and continuous tenements.

canonical_stones.label: The Crossroads of the Wind
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Four-breeze upland pasture col absorbed into an endless arterial overpass island.

canonical_stones.label: Boundless Mingled Streets
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Walking endlessly from one identical street to another without knowing whether one ever left or re-entered Cecilia.

canonical_stones.label: Ragged Graybeard & Wastepaper Goats
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Decades later, the aged graybeard drives gaunt, mangy goats cropping crumpled wastepaper from municipal garbage cans.

canonical_stones.label: Grass on the Traffic Island
canonical_stones.calvino_anchor: Stopping at a traffic island where the goats recognize the Meadow of the Low Sage: 'The places have mingled... Cecilia is everywhere.'

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html, 0 occurrences of forbidden external/relative substrings, 0 console/page errors at 1280x800 and 390x844.
hard_gates.HG-2: All 6 custom_dom_tags in <body>, zero generic div/section/header/footer/main/nav/span/button/p/h1..h6/input tags, 100% .cec-* CSS selectors, J_dom < 0.05.
hard_gates.HG-3: Era transition from Youthful Pastures to Mingled Everywhere sets outsideExists === false and pasturesMingledWithStreets === true; mangy goats crop curb wastepaper and recognize Meadow of the Low Sage on the traffic island.
hard_gates.HG-4: Royal Plates map.png (1600x1200), map.svg (1600x1200), and image.png (1600x1000) untouched on disk and rendered cleanly inside <cecilia-plate-drawer> with [P], [Z] zoom loupe, and Escape.
